📅 Slate Headlines + Flags

What is this? The top storylines for tonight's slate — where to stack, what to fade, and where the value is. Start here every day. Each card has a color-coded action tag and a link to the relevant board.
🌋
🌋 VOLCANO · STACK HOME

Las Vegas Ballpark +44% HR — slate's HR volcano

MIL @ ATH (10:05 ET). Home SP Jeffrey Springs V45.

Top bats here: Jake Bauers. Park also +35% Runs. Stack the home lineup.

→ See HR Board for these bats
🔥
STACK

HOU stack vs Grayson Rodriguez (V68 🔥 — slate-worst SP)

Angel Stadium +8% HR. HR Board: Yordan Alvarez #1 (76), Cam Smith #4 (67), Christian Walker #5 (65), Isaac Paredes #7 (62). Best same-game stack of the slate.

→ HR Board
🎯
STACK

SF stack vs Miles Mikolas (V68 🔥)

Oracle Park -22% HR. HR Board: Casey Schmitt #3 (71), Willy Adames #9 (60), Drew Gilbert #11 (57), Rafael Devers #17 (55). Cross-game complement to the top stack.

→ HR Board
⚡
K TARGET

Kyle Harrison 7.4 K leads the slate — Best Line: O 5+

MIL vs ATH V21. Gavin Williams 7 K (O 5+) is slate #2.

User rule: ≥5 K → O5+, 4.5–4.99 → O3.5, <4.5 → O2.5. Never alt above 5.

→ Full K's Board
☢️
HR RISK · STACK OPPS

Pitcher's HR Risk Board — stack opponents on these arms

Jeffrey Springs 0.94 HR/9 (vs MIL, V45), Kyle Harrison 0.92 HR/9 (vs ATH, V21). All have HR-stack potential.

→ Pitcher's HR Risk Board
🥶
FADE HR ALTS

HR-suppressed parks — fade the long ball here

Oracle Park -22% HR (WAS @ SF). Fade HR alts — pivot to 1+H / RBI / Runs plays. Las Vegas Ballpark +26% 2B/3B — pivot to doubles props there.

→ Park Factors Board
⛔
SKIP K PROPS

Arms below the O 2.5 floor — don't bet K props on these

Miles Mikolas (WAS, K 2.5). All below the alt floor. Pivot to 1+H / RBI plays instead.

→ Daily Skip List
